definitions.explanation: A systematic survey of the public's views on political, social, or other issues. Typically conducted by news organizations, government agencies, or research institutions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世論調査|よろんちょうさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The latest public opinion poll was released.

examples.japanese: {世論調査|よろんちょうさ}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧40%だった。
examples.english: According to the opinion poll, the cabinet approval rating was 40%.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{世論調査|よろんちょうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧し、⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Before the election, various companies conducted opinion polls and compared the candidates' approval ratings.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The reading よろん is now standard, though the original reading せろん also exists. Both ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧ and ⟦{世論|せろん}→世論：05315_seron⟧ are accepted, but よろん is far more common in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世論調査|よろんちょうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧ (to conduct a poll)
- {世論調査|よろんちょうさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (poll results)
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧ (cabinet approval rating — often cited from polls)
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧{世論調査|よろんちょうさ} (telephone opinion poll)

FORMS:
⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧ (public opinion) + ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (survey, investigation).
